segments.source: How to get help
segments.translation: 도움 받는 방법

segments.source: If you need assistance with one of your contributions, there are a few places you can go for help.
segments.translation: 기여와 관련해 도움이 필요할 때 찾아갈 수 있는 몇 가지 장소가 있습니다.

segments.source: How to find maintainers
segments.translation: 유지 관리자를 찾는 방법

segments.source: For better efficiency and a higher chance of success, you should try contacting individuals or groups with more specific knowledge first:
segments.translation: 더 효율적으로 그리고 성공 가능성을 높이려면, 더 구체적인 지식을 가진 개인이나 그룹에게 먼저 연락해 보아야 합니다.

segments.source: If your contribution is for a package in Nixpkgs, look for its maintainers in the [`maintainers`](https://nixos.org/manual/nixpkgs/stable/#var-meta-maintainers) attribute.
segments.translation: 기여하려는 대상이 Nixpkgs의 패키지라면 [`maintainers`](https://nixos.org/manual/nixpkgs/stable/#var-meta-maintainers) 속성에서 해당 패키지의 유지 관리자를 찾으십시오.

segments.source: Check if any teams are responsible for the relevant subsystem:
segments.translation: 관련 하위 시스템을 담당하는 팀이 있는지 확인하십시오.

segments.source: On the [NixOS website](https://nixos.org/community/#governance-teams).
segments.translation: [NixOS 웹사이트](https://nixos.org/community/#governance-teams)에서.

segments.source: In the [list of Nixpkgs maintainer teams](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/maintainers/team-list.nix).
segments.translation: [Nixpkgs 유지 관리자 팀 목록](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/maintainers/team-list.nix)에서.

segments.source: In the `CODEOWNERS` files for [Nixpkgs](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/ci/OWNERS) or [Nix](https://github.com/NixOS/nix/blob/master/.github/CODEOWNERS).
segments.translation: [Nixpkgs](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/ci/OWNERS) 또는 [Nix](https://github.com/NixOS/nix/blob/master/.github/CODEOWNERS)의 `CODEOWNERS` 파일에서.

segments.source: Check the output of [`git blame`](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-blame) or [`git log`](https://www.git-scm.com/docs/git-log) for the files you need help with.
segments.translation: 도움이 필요한 파일에 대해 [`git blame`](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-blame) 또는 [`git log`](https://www.git-scm.com/docs/git-log)의 출력을 확인하십시오.

segments.source: Take note of the email addresses of people who committed relevant code.
segments.translation: 관련 코드를 커밋한 사람들의 이메일 주소를 기록해 두십시오.

segments.source: Which communication channels to use
segments.translation: 어떤 커뮤니케이션 채널을 사용할지

segments.source: Once you've found the people you're looking for, you can contact them on one of the [community communication platforms](https://nixos.org/community):
segments.translation: 찾고 있는 사람을 발견했다면, [커뮤니티 커뮤니케이션 플랫폼](https://nixos.org/community) 중 하나로 연락할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: [GitHub](https://github.com/nixos)
segments.translation: [GitHub](https://github.com/nixos)

segments.source: All the source code is maintained on GitHub.
segments.translation: 모든 소스 코드는 GitHub에서 관리됩니다.

segments.source: This is the right place to discuss implementation details.
segments.translation: 구현 세부 사항을 논의하기에 적합한 곳입니다.

segments.source: In issue comments or pull request descriptions, [mention the GitHub username](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/getting-started-with-writing-and-formatting-on-github/basic-writing-and-formatting-syntax#mentioning-people-and-teams) found in the [`maintainers-list.nix` file](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/maintainers/maintainer-list.nix).
segments.translation: 이슈 댓글이나 풀 리퀘스트 설명에서, [`maintainers-list.nix` 파일](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/maintainers/maintainer-list.nix)에서 찾은 [GitHub 사용자 이름을 멘션하십시오](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/getting-started-with-writing-and-formatting-on-github/basic-writing-and-formatting-syntax#mentioning-people-and-teams).

segments.source: [Discourse](https://discourse.nixos.org)
segments.translation: [Discourse](https://discourse.nixos.org)

segments.source: Discourse is used for announcements, coordination, and open-ended questions.
segments.translation: Discourse는 공지, 조율, 그리고 개방형 질문에 사용됩니다.

segments.source: Try the GitHub username found in the [`maintainers-list.nix` file][maintainers-list] to mention or directly contact a specific user.
segments.translation: [`maintainers-list.nix` 파일][maintainers-list]에서 찾은 GitHub 사용자 이름을 사용하여 특정 사용자를 멘션하거나 직접 연락해 보십시오.
issues: Term 'maintainers' should be translated as '유지 관리자' but was not found in translation

segments.source: Note that some people use a different username on Discourse.
segments.translation: 일부 사람들은 Discourse에서 다른 사용자 이름을 사용한다는 점에 유의하십시오.

segments.source: [Matrix]
segments.translation: [Matrix]

segments.source: Matrix is used for short-lived, timely exchanges, and direct messages.
segments.translation: Matrix는 짧고 즉각적인 대화 및 다이렉트 메시지에 사용됩니다.

segments.source: To contact a maintainer, use their Matrix handle found in the [`maintainers-list.nix` file][maintainers-list].
segments.translation: 유지 관리자에게 연락하려면 [`maintainers-list.nix` 파일][maintainers-list]에서 찾은 그들의 Matrix 핸들을 사용하십시오.

segments.source: If no Matrix handle is present for a specific maintainer, try searching for their GitHub username, as most people tend to use the same one across channels.
segments.translation: 특정 유지 관리자에 대한 Matrix 핸들이 없다면, 대부분의 사람들이 채널마다 같은 이름을 사용하는 경향이 있으므로 GitHub 사용자 이름으로 검색해 보십시오.

segments.source: Maintainer teams sometimes have their own public Matrix room.
segments.translation: 유지 관리자 팀은 때때로 자체 공개 Matrix 방을 가지고 있습니다.

segments.source: Email
segments.translation: 이메일

segments.source: Use email addresses found with `git log`.
segments.translation: `git log`로 찾은 이메일 주소를 사용하십시오.

segments.source: Meetings and events
segments.translation: 회의 및 이벤트

segments.source: Check the [official NixOS Calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/embed?src=b9o52fobqjak8oq8lfkhg3t0qg@group.calendar.google.com) and the [Discourse community calendar](https://discourse.nixos.org/t/community-calendar/18589) for real-time or in-person events.
segments.translation: 실시간 또는 오프라인 이벤트를 확인하려면 [공식 NixOS 캘린더](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/embed?src=b9o52fobqjak8oq8lfkhg3t0qg@group.calendar.google.com)와 [Discourse 커뮤니티 캘린더](https://discourse.nixos.org/t/community-calendar/18589)를 확인하십시오.

segments.source: Some community teams hold regular meetings and publish their meeting notes.
segments.translation: 일부 커뮤니티 팀은 정기 회의를 열고 회의록을 공개합니다.

segments.source: Other venues
segments.translation: 그 밖의 장소

segments.source: If you haven't found any specific users or groups that could help you with your contribution, you can resort to asking the community at large, using one of the following official communication channels:
segments.translation: 기여에 도움이 될 만한 특정 사용자나 그룹을 찾지 못했다면, 다음 공식 소통 채널 중 하나를 이용하여 커뮤니티 전체에 질문하는 방법도 있습니다:

segments.source: A room related to your question in the [NixOS Matrix space][matrix].
segments.translation: [NixOS Matrix 스페이스][matrix]에서 질문과 관련된 방.

segments.source: The [*Help* category](https://discourse.nixos.org/c/learn/9) on Discourse.
segments.translation: Discourse의 [*Help* 카테고리](https://discourse.nixos.org/c/learn/9).

segments.source: The general [`#nix`](https://matrix.to/#/#nix:nixos.org) room on Matrix.
segments.translation: Matrix의 일반 [`#nix`](https://matrix.to/#/#nix:nixos.org) 방.
